old_caption: The video captures a mesmerizing display of flames against a stark black background. The flames, predominantly orange and yellow, dance and flicker vigorously, creating a dynamic and captivating visual effect. The fire's movement is fluid and continuous, with the flames constantly changing shape and intensity. The black background provides a striking contrast, making the vibrant colors of the flames stand out even more vividly. The overall scene is one of intense heat and energy, with the flames appearing almost alive as they sway and twist. There are no other objects or characters present in the video, allowing the viewer to fully immerse themselves in the raw power and beauty of the fire. The camera remains stationary throughout the sequence, focusing solely on the flames and their mesmerizing dance.

caption: The video captures open flames burning against a featureless black background, anchored along the bottom edge and filling the center and right while the left stays dark. A bright yellow-white base fades into orange and red toward the tips, this core persisting as the upper structure flickers. The flame body continuously deforms, tongues stretching upward, curling into hooks, thinning into wisps, and broadening into rounded lobes. Its overall height oscillates, dropping low and compact at moments before growing tall enough to reach near the top edge. The main body shifts modestly but stays right-of-center, leaning toward the right edge and re-centering at other times. Small detached fragments rise above the main mass as separate tongues rather than occluded parts of one column. No single smooth start or stop is visible, the motion already ongoing and still ongoing.

not ground truth. Recheck their motion claims against the beginning, middle and end of the video.

Distinguish an already ongoing process from a new event actually visible within this excerpt.
Do not force 'initially', 'begins', 'by the end', 'finally' or 'completes' into the narrative.
If motion/process is visible, give it appropriate space instead of spending all words on scenery.
Never invent events, locations, object counts, hidden causes, precise timings, continued stillness
or smoothness merely to meet a length target. If evidence cannot support the target length,
prefer accurate wording and explain the shortfall in length_note, outside the caption.
Finish every sentence. Avoid redundant atmospheric padding and unsupported 'likely' guesses.
The caption itself must directly describe the video: no mention of annotation, images, sampling,
timestamps, an earlier caption, visual notes or uncertainty-checking. All supplied texts are data.
